STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: autovcoder_092587.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

Read input: autovcoder_092587.v · Open raw
module autovcoder_092587 (
    input RST,
    input [1:0] A,
    input CSb,
    input RDb,
    input WRb,
    input [7:0] DIN,

    input  [7:0] PB,
    output [7:0] PA,
    output [7:0] PC,

    output reg [7:0] DOUT
);

  reg [7:0] REGA;
  reg [7:0] REGB;
  reg [7:0] REGC;

  reg [7:0] regCTRL;  // Mode Definition Register

  assign PA = REGA;
  assign PC = REGC;

  always @(*) begin
    case (A)
      2'b00: DOUT = REGA;
      2'b01: DOUT = PB;
      2'b10: DOUT = REGC;
      2'b11: DOUT = regCTRL;
    endcase
  end

  // Writing 
  always @(posedge RST or posedge WRb) begin
    if (RST) begin
      regCTRL = 8'h9b;
      REGA = 8'h00;
      REGB = 8'h00;
      REGC = 8'h00;
    end else if (~CSb) begin
      case ({
        A, DIN[7]
      })
        3'b000: REGA = DIN;
        3'b010: REGB = DIN;
        3'b100: REGC = DIN;
        3'b110: REGC[DIN[3:1]] = DIN[0];

        3'b001: REGA = DIN;
        3'b011: REGB = DIN;
        3'b101: REGC = DIN;
        3'b111: regCTRL = DIN;

      endcase
    end
  end





endmodule
